findings.words: Every performance read on the page answered DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: 24 of 24 API answers, both accounts, all four presets and the deep presses (shots 009-026). The refusal panel and the raw code under Details are on every one. No COT figure exists on the page at any period.

findings.read: CONFIRMED (this seat's read, not a check hit)
findings.words: Three scope controls on one tab do not follow each other: the page's Account picker, the map's chips (one row per account, one chip per model), and the securities table's own Sleeve and Account selects. Shot 042: the page picker reads one account, the map chip reads 'Model: DIVZ SMA', the table's Sleeve reads 'Opal Ultra Short-Term Income' -- three scopes on one screen. AD-01 says the map and the table follow the card's selection.
Two source footers disagree on one tab: the card's reads 'Source: Opal Capital Analysis.' and the map's and table's read 'Source: holdings_snapshot.build_cot.' (shots 027, 030, 042).

The map's tile labels are the share of the CLIENT total (0.2%-0.4% per single stock under the DIVZ SMA chip, shot 042) while the grouping rule is the share of the DISPLAYED set (none of those tiles is grouped although each is under 2% of the client). Two bases on one map; the stated rule must say which.

The opened tile's dialog (shot 039) carries the sliver bar Andrew flagged, over the SMA's single stocks listed with blue dots; the dialog's text is what the contrast check flags (24 elements) on the band gradient.

Back and Next are whole at the walk's viewport (shot 052); Andrew's capture (analysis_4) clips Next at a narrower window. Viewport-dependent: a responsive check, not a fixed defect. W2-16 is downgraded to PARTIAL.

Pressing a VARIANT card opens the canonical HeroDialog -- 'Multi-Comp: WHAT IT IS / WHAT IT NEEDS: Two to 5 comparisons ... each an Opal model, or an external ETF by its symbol' with a 'Select this analysis' action (shot 051). AD-08 is landing; the comparisons picker Andrew asks for is this modal's second page.

Eleven of thirteen request rows still read 'Checking status...' after the page's settle (shot 052): the list's per-row status reads are in flight one by one. Two rows read 'Unavailable -- needs attention. Open it to see what to change.' (the check's unconnected-field hit) and one 'Loading -- Running -- in progress'.

Identity shows WHO / HOW MUCH / AS OF / OVER WHAT and nothing else; 'About this scope' is gone (shot 005). AD-13 is met on this client; AD-10 is met on it too (each account's own tail on Identity, the pickers and Analysis).

Known classes, not re-litigated: the empty page's 'Illustrative sample' block (3 bands on the empty page, 5 on Holdings -- UIR-40, C3); the contrast heuristic on tile text over the band gradient and on the dialog (7 hits); ellipsized names in the securities table and the map (6 truncated-label hits -- W2-15's port removes the ticker-in-name that causes most of them).
